student_learning_goal: I can compare a prediction to actual data and refine my model.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can compare a prediction to actual data and refine my model.
header.character_watermark: Mayor Mira in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in tall).

parts.student_instructions: Compare 5 predict-vs-actual scenarios. Find each gap.
parts.visual_layout: Top of page. Five comparison rows.

image_placeholders.description: Five comparison rows in B&W line-art, ~7in x 3.5in. Columns: 'Predict | Actual | Gap'. Pre-filled: row 1 (25, 23, ___), row 2 (300, 285, ___), row 3 (72, 80, ___), row 4 (50, 50, ___), row 5 (60, 65, ___). Header 'Predict vs Actual:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS04_P1_COMPARE: keywords (predict, actual) name what the rows ask for.

parts.answer_key: Row 1 gap: 2 less. Row 2 gap: 15 less. Row 3 gap: 8 more. Row 4 gap: 0 (matched). Row 5 gap: 5 more.

parts.student_instructions: Each rule below was a bit off. Refine the rule based on actual data.
parts.visual_layout: Middle of page. Three rule-refining boxes.

image_placeholders.description: Three refining boxes in B&W line-art, ~7in x 2.5in. Each box: 'Old rule: ___' and 'Refined rule: ___'. Pre-filled old rules: '5 buses/day (actual avg 4.6)', '60 sandwiches/lunch (actual avg 57)', '72 books/week (actual 80)'. Header 'Refine the Rule:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS04_P2_REFINE: keywords (refine, rule) name what the boxes ask for.

parts.answer_key: Open. Each refined rule should be closer to the actual data.

parts.student_instructions: Think of a real-life prediction you made. Did it match? How would you refine?
parts.visual_layout: Bottom of page. A drawing or writing box with reflection lines.

image_placeholders.description: A blank reflection area in B&W line-art, ~7in x 2.5in. 'I predicted: ___'. 'Actual: ___'. 'I would refine to: ___'. Header 'My Real-Life Refinement:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS04_P3_MY: keywords (my, refinement) name what the box asks for.

parts.answer_key: Open. Should include a refined rule.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, refine TWO rules for the same situation.
teacher_notes: Lesson 4 worksheet practices C4 step 4 reflect/refine. Watch for wrong-vs-imperfect framing.
